# Rules

<!-- GENERATED by tool/generate.dart from tool/decisions.yaml. Do not edit. -->

A decision for every lint rule of Dart SDK 3.14.0 (250 rules; 14 removed rules are not listed). Source: [SDK catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dart-lang/sdk/3.14.0/pkg/linter/tool/machine/rules.json).

- `core`: 68 rules (`core.yaml`)
- `strict`: 128 more rules (`strict.yaml` = `core` + these)
- `off`: 54 rules

The `dart fix` column says whether `dart fix --apply` can fix the rule automatically.

| Rule | Level | `dart fix` | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`always_declare_return_types`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_declare_return_types) | core | yes | An omitted return type silently becomes `dynamic`. |
| [`always_put_control_body_on_new_line`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_put_control_body_on_new_line) | off | yes | Layout belongs to the formatter. |
| [`always_put_required_named_parameters_first`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_put_required_named_parameters_first) | off | yes | Conflicts with the Flutter convention of `key` first in widget constructors. |
| [`always_specify_types`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_specify_types) | off | yes | Annotating every type adds noise without catching bugs; we annotate only non-obvious types. |
| [`always_use_package_imports`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/always_use_package_imports) | strict | yes | One import style for `lib/`; a package URI reads the same from every file. |
| [`annotate_overrides`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/annotate_overrides) | core | yes | Without `@override`, renaming a super member silently leaves a stale method behind. |
| [`annotate_redeclares`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/annotate_redeclares) (experimental) | off | yes | Experimental in the SDK. |
| [`async_return_with_no_await`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/async_return_with_no_await) | core | yes | Without `await`, errors of the returned future bypass the surrounding `try` and the frame is missing from stack traces. |
| [`avoid_annotating_with_dynamic`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_annotating_with_dynamic) | strict | yes | Writing `dynamic` where inference already gives it is noise. |
| [`avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions) | strict | yes | `c ? true : x` reads better as a boolean expression. |
| [`avoid_catches_without_on_clauses`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_catches_without_on_clauses) | off | no | Catch-all handlers at error-reporting boundaries are intended; flagging each one trains people to ignore the rule. |
| [`avoid_catching_errors`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_catching_errors) | strict | no | An `Error` signals a programming bug; catching it hides the bug. |
| [`avoid_classes_with_only_static_members`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_classes_with_only_static_members) | off | no | Design tokens are grouped as static constants of a class (`AppSpacing.md`); the namespace is the point. |
| [`avoid_double_and_int_checks`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_double_and_int_checks) | off | no | Matters only when compiling to JavaScript; packages targeting the web can enable it. |
| [`avoid_dynamic_calls`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_dynamic_calls) | core | no | Calls on `dynamic` skip static checking and fail only at runtime. |
| [`avoid_empty_else`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_empty_else) | core | yes | `else ;` usually means the next statement was meant to be conditional. |
| [`avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes) | strict | no | Value equality on a mutable object breaks `Set` and `Map` lookups after mutation. |
| [`avoid_escaping_inner_quotes`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_escaping_inner_quotes) | strict | yes | Switching the outer quotes is easier to read than escapes. |
| [`avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes) | strict | no | In a const class a getter makes it clear the value is not per-instance state. |
| [`avoid_final_parameters`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_final_parameters) | off | yes | We neither require nor forbid `final` on parameters. |
| [`avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_function_literals_in_foreach_calls) | strict | yes | `for-in` supports `await`, `break` and `return`; `forEach` with a closure does not. |
| [`avoid_futureor_void`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_futureor_void) (experimental) | off | no | Experimental in the SDK. |
| [`avoid_implementing_value_types`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_implementing_value_types) | strict | no | Implementing a class with a custom `==` breaks its equality contract. |
| [`avoid_init_to_null`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_init_to_null) | strict | yes | Nullable variables already start as `null`. |
| [`avoid_js_rounded_ints`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_js_rounded_ints) | off | no | Matters only when compiling to JavaScript; packages targeting the web can enable it. |
| [`avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_multiple_declarations_per_line) | strict | yes | One declaration per line keeps diffs and reviews focused. |
| [`avoid_null_checks_in_equality_operators`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_null_checks_in_equality_operators) (deprecated) | off | yes | Deprecated in the SDK. |
| [`avoid_positional_boolean_parameters`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_positional_boolean_parameters) | strict | no | `f(true)` says nothing at the call site; a named parameter does. |
| [`avoid_print`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_print) | core | yes | `print` ends up in device logs of release builds; use a logger. |
| [`avoid_private_typedef_functions`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_private_typedef_functions) (deprecated) | off | yes | Deprecated in the SDK. |
| [`avoid_redundant_argument_values`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_redundant_argument_values) | strict | yes | Passing the default value hides which arguments actually matter. |
| [`avoid_relative_lib_imports`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_relative_lib_imports) | core | yes | Mixing relative and package imports of `lib/` can load one library twice, giving two distinct types. |
| [`avoid_renaming_method_parameters`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_renaming_method_parameters) | strict | yes | Renamed parameters in overrides make inherited docs refer to names that do not exist. |
| [`avoid_return_types_on_setters`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_return_types_on_setters) | strict | yes | A setter's return type is always `void`. |
| [`avoid_returning_null_for_void`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_returning_null_for_void) | strict | yes | `return null;` in a `void` function suggests a value that is never used. |
| [`avoid_returning_this`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_returning_this) | off | no | Fluent builders are legitimate and cascades do not fit every API. |
| [`avoid_setters_without_getters`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_setters_without_getters) | strict | no | A write-only property is surprising; use a method. |
| [`avoid_shadowing_type_parameters`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_shadowing_type_parameters) | core | no | A shadowed type parameter refers to a different type than it appears to. |
| [`avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_single_cascade_in_expression_statements) | strict | yes | A single cascade is a plain call written in a confusing way. |
| [`avoid_slow_async_io`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_slow_async_io) | off | no | Async I/O keeps the UI isolate responsive; the speed difference rarely matters. |
| [`avoid_type_to_string`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_type_to_string) | core | no | Type names are minified in release builds, so logic or logs based on them break. |
| [`avoid_types_as_parameter_names`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_types_as_parameter_names) | core | no | `(int) {}` declares a parameter named `int` of type `dynamic`, not an int. |
| [`avoid_types_on_closure_parameters`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_types_on_closure_parameters) | strict | yes | Closure parameter types are inferred from context. |
| [`avoid_unnecessary_containers`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_unnecessary_containers) | strict | yes | A `Container` with only a child adds a widget without effect. |
| [`avoid_unused_constructor_parameters`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_unused_constructor_parameters) | core | yes | An unused constructor parameter usually means a forgotten field assignment. |
| [`avoid_void_async`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_void_async) | core | yes | An `async` function returning `void` cannot be awaited and its errors are lost; return `Future<void>`. |
| [`avoid_web_libraries_in_flutter`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/avoid_web_libraries_in_flutter) | core | no | Web-only imports break mobile builds. |
| [`await_only_futures`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/await_only_futures) | core | yes | Awaiting a non-future usually means a wrong type or a missing call. |
| [`camel_case_extensions`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/camel_case_extensions) | core | no | Naming per Effective Dart; part of every package's public API. |
| [`camel_case_types`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/camel_case_types) | core | no | Naming per Effective Dart; part of every package's public API. |
| [`cancel_subscriptions`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/cancel_subscriptions) | core | no | An uncancelled subscription leaks and keeps firing after dispose. |
| [`cascade_invocations`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/cascade_invocations) | off | yes | Forcing cascades on consecutive calls often hurts readability. |
| [`cast_nullable_to_non_nullable`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/cast_nullable_to_non_nullable) | core | yes | `x as T` on a nullable value hides a null check; use `!` or handle null. |
| [`close_sinks`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/close_sinks) | core | no | An unclosed sink leaks resources. |
| [`collection_methods_unrelated_type`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/collection_methods_unrelated_type) | core | no | `contains('1')` on a `List<int>` is always false. |
| [`combinators_ordering`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/combinators_ordering) | strict | yes | Sorted `show`/`hide` names avoid merge conflicts. |
| [`comment_references`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/comment_references) | strict | yes | A broken `[reference]` in a doc comment silently renders as plain text. |
| [`conditional_uri_does_not_exist`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/conditional_uri_does_not_exist) | core | no | A missing conditional import fails only on the platform that selects it. |
| [`constant_identifier_names`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/constant_identifier_names) | core | yes | Naming per Effective Dart; part of every package's public API. |
| [`control_flow_in_finally`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/control_flow_in_finally) | core | no | `return` or `break` in `finally` swallows the exception in flight. |
| [`curly_braces_in_flow_control_structures`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/curly_braces_in_flow_control_structures) | core | yes | A body without braces invites the "second statement is not conditional" bug. |
| [`dangling_library_doc_comments`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/dangling_library_doc_comments) | strict | yes | A doc comment attached to nothing is not shown by `dart doc`. |
| [`depend_on_referenced_packages`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/depend_on_referenced_packages) | core | no | Importing a transitive dependency breaks when that dependency changes. |
| [`deprecated_consistency`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/deprecated_consistency) | strict | no | A deprecated field with a non-deprecated parameter (or the reverse) sends mixed signals. |
| [`deprecated_member_use_from_same_package`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/deprecated_member_use_from_same_package) | off | yes | A package keeps using its own deprecated API until removal; external users are still warned. |
| [`diagnostic_describe_all_properties`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/diagnostic_describe_all_properties) | off | yes | Requires `debugFillProperties` boilerplate in every widget; little value in app code. |
| [`directives_ordering`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/directives_ordering) | strict | yes | A fixed import order avoids merge conflicts. |
| [`discarded_futures`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/discarded_futures) | off | yes | Flutter's sync callbacks (`initState`, `onPressed`) routinely start futures; `unawaited_futures` covers async bodies. |
| [`do_not_use_environment`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/do_not_use_environment) | off | no | Apps read `--dart-define-from-file` configuration through `String.fromEnvironment` by design. |
| [`document_ignores`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/document_ignores) | strict | no | An `ignore` without a reason cannot be reviewed or removed later. |
| [`empty_catches`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/empty_catches) | core | yes | A silently swallowed exception hides failures. |
| [`empty_constructor_bodies`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/empty_constructor_bodies) | strict | yes | `;` instead of `{}` is the idiomatic empty body. |
| [`empty_container_bodies`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/empty_container_bodies) | strict | yes | `;` instead of `{}` is the idiomatic empty body. |
| [`empty_statements`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/empty_statements) | core | yes | A stray `;` after `if` makes the following block unconditional. |
| [`eol_at_end_of_file`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/eol_at_end_of_file) | strict | yes | A missing final newline produces noisy diffs. |
| [`exhaustive_cases`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/exhaustive_cases) | core | yes | A new constant of an enum-like class must not be silently ignored by a switch. |
| [`file_names`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/file_names) | core | no | Naming per Effective Dart; mixed-case file names break on case-insensitive file systems. |
| [`flutter_style_todos`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/flutter_style_todos) | strict | yes | A TODO with an owner and a link can be tracked. |
| [`future_sync_value`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/future_sync_value) | off | yes | New stable rule; we will evaluate it in the starter kit before enabling it. |
| [`hash_and_equals`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/hash_and_equals) | core | yes | Overriding only one of `==` and `hashCode` breaks hash-based collections. |
| [`implementation_imports`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/implementation_imports) | core | no | Another package's `src/` is not its public API and can change in any release. |
| [`implicit_call_tearoffs`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/implicit_call_tearoffs) | strict | yes | An explicit `.call` tear-off shows that an object is used as a function. |
| [`implicit_reopen`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/implicit_reopen) (experimental) | off | yes | Experimental in the SDK. |
| [`initialize_in_field_declaration`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/initialize_in_field_declaration) | strict | yes | Initializing at the declaration keeps the value next to the field. |
| [`invalid_case_patterns`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/invalid_case_patterns) (experimental) | off | yes | Experimental in the SDK and only useful for Dart 2 migrations. |
| [`invalid_runtime_check_with_js_interop_types`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/invalid_runtime_check_with_js_interop_types) | off | no | Applies only to JS interop; packages targeting the web can enable it. |
| [`join_return_with_assignment`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/join_return_with_assignment) | strict | no | Assigning a local only to return it on the next line is noise. |
| [`leading_newlines_in_multiline_strings`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/leading_newlines_in_multiline_strings) | strict | yes | Content starting on the next line keeps multiline strings aligned. |
| [`library_annotations`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/library_annotations) | strict | yes | Library-level annotations belong on the `library` directive. |
| [`library_names`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/library_names) | core | no | Naming per Effective Dart; part of every package's public API. |
| [`library_prefixes`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/library_prefixes) | core | no | Naming per Effective Dart; part of every package's public API. |
| [`library_private_types_in_public_api`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/library_private_types_in_public_api) | core | no | Callers cannot name a private type used in a public signature. |
| [`lines_longer_than_80_chars`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/lines_longer_than_80_chars) | off | no | Line length belongs to the formatter. |
| [`literal_only_boolean_expressions`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/literal_only_boolean_expressions) | core | no | `if (true)` is dead code or a debugging leftover. |
| [`matching_super_parameters`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/matching_super_parameters) | strict | no | A super parameter named differently from the super constructor's parameter misleads readers. |
| [`migrate_design_widgets`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/migrate_design_widgets) | off | yes | New stable rule; we will evaluate it in the starter kit before enabling it. |
| [`missing_code_block_language_in_doc_comment`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/missing_code_block_language_in_doc_comment) | strict | no | Code blocks without a language get no highlighting in `dart doc`. |
| [`missing_whitespace_between_adjacent_strings`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/missing_whitespace_between_adjacent_strings) | core | no | `'Hello' 'world'` renders as `Helloworld`. |
| [`no_adjacent_strings_in_list`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_adjacent_strings_in_list) | core | no | A missing comma between two strings silently merges two list elements. |
| [`no_default_cases`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_default_cases) (experimental) | off | no | Experimental in the SDK. |
| [`no_duplicate_case_values`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_duplicate_case_values) | core | yes | A duplicate case value is unreachable. |
| [`no_dynamic_casts`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_dynamic_casts) | core | no | Implicit casts from `dynamic` fail at runtime; an explicit `as` keeps them visible. |
| [`no_leading_underscores_for_library_prefixes`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_leading_underscores_for_library_prefixes) | strict | yes | Library prefixes are not members, so privacy underscores mean nothing. |
| [`no_leading_underscores_for_local_identifiers`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_leading_underscores_for_local_identifiers) | strict | yes | Locals are not members, so privacy underscores mean nothing. |
| [`no_literal_bool_comparisons`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_literal_bool_comparisons) | strict | yes | `x == true` is a longer `x`. |
| [`no_logic_in_create_state`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_logic_in_create_state) | core | no | `createState` must only create the state; logic there runs at the wrong time. |
| [`no_raw_types`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_raw_types) | core | no | A raw generic type silently uses its bounds and loses type information. |
| [`no_runtimetype_tostring`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_runtimetype_tostring) | core | no | `runtimeType.toString()` is slow and minified in release builds. |
| [`no_self_assignments`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_self_assignments) | core | no | `x = x` is always a mistake. |
| [`no_wildcard_variable_uses`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/no_wildcard_variable_uses) | core | no | `_` is a wildcard; reading it relies on pre-wildcard semantics. |
| [`non_constant_identifier_names`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/non_constant_identifier_names) | core | yes | Naming per Effective Dart; part of every package's public API. |
| [`noop_primitive_operations`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/noop_primitive_operations) | strict | yes | Operations like `x.toString()` on a String do nothing. |
| [`null_check_on_nullable_type_parameter`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/null_check_on_nullable_type_parameter) | core | yes | `x!` on `T?` throws for a valid `null` when `T` itself is nullable. |
| [`null_closures`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/null_closures) | core | yes | Passing `null` where a closure is expected throws at runtime. |
| [`omit_local_variable_types`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/omit_local_variable_types) | off | yes | An annotation on a non-obvious local can help readers; we forbid only obvious ones (`omit_obvious_local_variable_types`). |
| [`omit_obvious_local_variable_types`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/omit_obvious_local_variable_types) | strict | yes | An annotation repeating an obvious type is noise. |
| [`omit_obvious_property_types`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/omit_obvious_property_types) | strict | yes | An annotation repeating an obvious type is noise. |
| [`one_member_abstracts`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/one_member_abstracts) (deprecated) | off | no | Deprecated in the SDK. |
| [`only_throw_errors`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/only_throw_errors) | core | no | Throwing strings or other objects defeats `on` clauses and typed error handling. |
| [`overridden_fields`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/overridden_fields) | core | no | An overriding field duplicates storage and hides the super field. |
| [`package_names`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/package_names) | core | no | Naming per Effective Dart; pub.dev requires it. |
| [`package_prefixed_library_names`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/package_prefixed_library_names) | off | no | We do not name libraries at all (`unnecessary_library_name`). |
| [`parameter_assignments`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/parameter_assignments) | strict | no | Reassigning a parameter hides the original argument from the rest of the body. |
| [`prefer_adjacent_string_concatenation`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_adjacent_string_concatenation) | strict | yes | Adjacent literals need no `+`. |
| [`prefer_asserts_in_initializer_lists`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_asserts_in_initializer_lists) | strict | no | Asserts in the initializer list run before the constructor body. |
| [`prefer_asserts_with_message`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_asserts_with_message) | off | no | Assert conditions are usually self-explanatory; mandatory messages become restatements. |
| [`prefer_collection_literals`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_collection_literals) | strict | yes | Literals are shorter and infer types better than constructors. |
| [`prefer_conditional_assignment`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_conditional_assignment) | strict | yes | `??=` states the intent directly. |
| [`prefer_const_constructors`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_const_constructors) | strict | yes | Const instances are canonicalized, and const widgets are skipped on rebuild. |
| [`prefer_const_constructors_in_immutables`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_const_constructors_in_immutables) | strict | yes | An immutable class with a const constructor can be used in const expressions. |
| [`prefer_const_declarations`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_const_declarations) | strict | yes | `const` makes a compile-time constant explicit. |
| [`prefer_const_literals_to_create_immutables`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_const_literals_to_create_immutables) | strict | yes | Const literals let the enclosing widget be const. |
| [`prefer_constructors_over_static_methods`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_constructors_over_static_methods) | strict | no | A named constructor is the idiomatic way to create an instance. |
| [`prefer_contains`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_contains) | strict | yes | `contains` states the intent better than `indexOf(x) != -1`. |
| [`prefer_double_quotes`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_double_quotes) | off | yes | We use single quotes (`prefer_single_quotes`). |
| [`prefer_expression_function_bodies`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_expression_function_bodies) | off | yes | Forcing `=>` for every single-return body hurts readability of longer expressions. |
| [`prefer_final_fields`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_final_fields) | strict | yes | A private field that is never reassigned should say so. |
| [`prefer_final_in_for_each`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_final_in_for_each) | strict | yes | A loop variable that is never reassigned should say so. |
| [`prefer_final_locals`](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/prefer_final_locals) | strict | yes | A local that is never reassigned should say so. |
